note: Recorded by a one-off script from the Stanza accurate-package parses of gold-matching train rows of symbolic_english (rules v2.0 replay, eval/reports/current/symbolic-accurate): one row per tree repair and per v2.0 pattern. `sop` is the SOP the rules produce (equal to the row gold under strict execution equivalence). The parses are of ChatSOP-authored sentences.

cases.label: repair:strandedCopula
cases.message: Tell me which town Delta Print is in.

parse.text: Tell me which town Delta Print is in.

sentences.text: Tell me which town Delta Print is in.

cases.sop:
@q query
  select ?place
  where match
    relation "be in"
    role subject "Delta Print"
    role location ?place
    polarity affirmed
  end

cases.label: pattern:given
cases.message: Given that Pablo manages Liviu; he doesn't manage Liviu, can you check whether he is the boss of Liviu?

parse.text: Given that Pablo manages Liviu; he doesn't manage Liviu, can you check whether he is the boss of Liviu?

sentences.text: Given that Pablo manages Liviu; he doesn't manage Liviu, can you check whether he is the boss of Liviu?

cases.sop:
@s1 stated
  relation "manage"
  role subject "Pablo"
  role object "Liviu"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "manage"
  role subject "Pablo"
  role object "Liviu"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted

@a1 assumed
  relation "refer to"
  role subject "he"
  role object "Pablo"
  polarity affirmed
  basis disambiguation

@q query
  where match
    relation "be the boss of"
    role object "Liviu"
    role subject "Pablo"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  because $s1
